id: title:ablaszkiewicz:stop the sync from restarting stopped devboxes

review.posthog_relevance: Devbox infrastructure maintenance: Pausing and resuming the devbox mirror while the box is stopped, and resuming it when started, could preserve mirror state and avoid unnecessary re-syncs or connection failures.
review.reason: Adds documentation and implementation for pausing and resuming the devbox mirror when the box is stopped, and for resuming the mirror when the box is started.
review.uncertainty: The benefit relies on the devbox infrastructure context not provided in the patch; no adoption, incident, or benefit is demonstrated. The tier is assigned based on the presence of implementation and documentation, not on verified outcomes.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs are present. No adoption, incident, or benefit is demonstrated. No tier is assigned.
